reddit.title: Exciting Updates: Multi-Language Support and Improved Placement Feedback in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements in Provincia! Our build UI now supports ten languages, ensuring a more inclusive experience for players worldwide. Additionally, we've enhanced placement feedback, so you'll know exactly why a placement failed. Plus, our day/night transitions are smoother, preventing any hitches during gameplay. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ten-locales-clearer-placement?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ten-locales-clearer-placement

steam.title: Provincia Update: Multi-Language Support and Enhanced Gameplay
steam.body: We're excited to share that Provincia now supports ten languages, making it easier for players around the globe to enjoy the game. Additionally, we've improved placement feedback to clearly indicate why a placement failed, along with smoother transitions between day and night. For more details, visit our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ten-locales-clearer-placement?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ten-locales-clearer-placement
